title: Hubble's Gravitational Lens Gallery Sets Targets for Roman
paragraphs: On 12 November 2026, NASA shared a set of Hubble pictures of strong gravitational lenses. A gravitational lens happens when a heavy galaxy or a group of galaxies bends and magnifies the light from a galaxy far behind it.

Some of the pictures show rings or the same galaxy copied four times. These lenses were first found with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument in the United States. After that, Hubble took a closer look.

Now the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, which launched in August 2026, will observe them too. Scientists want to measure the mass of each lens galaxy, including its dark matter, and to test an idea about how dark matter is built.
